name: RTX HDR Image Booster
description: Lists images, videos, and streams found on any page in a popup, and turns directly-opened images into live canvas-stream video so RTX Video HDR tone-maps them like real video. Convert/revert any image individually or all at once, open local pictures/folders from your PC, and export a real Ultra HDR (.jpg) file of any converted image. Optional toggle to auto-convert on every page.

action.default_title: RTX HDR Image Booster — view detected images
